title: P2c: ambient/module source resolution of a missing import
intent: Decide whether an import is satisfied only by the exact relative path from the importing file, or by any ambient/module source in the workspace: sub/a.ostw imports ghost.del while ghost.del exists only at the project root.

provenance.origin: Wright QA semantic probe for issue #118

provenanceNote: QA-authored source. ghost.del exists at the project root; sub/a.ostw imports "ghost.del" which does not exist in sub/. If the reference resolves strictly relative to the importing file, the import is missing despite the ambient root-level module.
